hooks.name: Prompt context and secret scan
hooks.description: Blocks a prompt that contains a secret (AGENTS.md: no secrets in prompts), and otherwise adds a short shared vocabulary and the count of open spec tasks to every turn.

action.command: in=$(cat 2>/dev/null); p=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.prompt? // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$p" ] || p="$USER_PROMPT"; [ -n "$p" ] || p="$in"; if printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eq 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token)[[:space:]]*[=:][[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]{8,}'; then echo 'prompt-context: this prompt looks like it contains a secret. Remove it and use an environment variable or the keychain; secrets never go in prompts or logs.' >&2; exit 2; fi; open=$(cat .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^- \[ \]'); echo "Afterglow vocabulary: unknown = fail closed; cell = geohash-6 with k >= 5 devices; ward = refused unsafe action; label is the law (validated formulary only); Night Shell = red on black, tokens only. Open spec tasks: $open."; exit 0
